title: Swedish Bus Quiz: Can You Understand These 3 Phrases? | SvenskaVardag
text:
Can you catch what people say on a Swedish bus? 🚌 Three quick questions, guess A or B and count your score.

🎓 ska av = getting off, ska på = getting on.
